units.source_text: 大皇子是右大臣之女弘徽殿女御所生，有高贵的外戚作后盾，毫无疑义，当然是人人爱戴的东宫太子。

en.t: The eldest prince was born to the Kokiden Consort, daughter of the Minister of the Right, and with such noble maternal relatives behind him, he was unquestionably the Crown Prince beloved by everyone.

units.source_text: 然而讲到相貌，总比不上这小皇子的清秀俊美。

en.t: Yet when it came to looks, he could never match the delicate and handsome beauty of this younger prince.

units.source_text: 因此皇上对于大皇子，只是一般的珍爱，

en.t: For that reason, the Emperor cherished the eldest prince only in the ordinary way,

units.source_text: 而把这小皇子看作自己私人的秘宝，加以无限宠爱。

en.t: while he regarded this younger prince as his own private treasure and lavished boundless affection on him.
